segments.name: Truck Segment
segments.description: Operates commercial vehicle dealerships selling new and used trucks, parts, service, financing, leasing, rental and insurance to fleet customers.
segments.evidence: The Truck Segment includes our operation of a network of commercial vehicle dealerships under the name "Rush Truck Centers."

revenueModel.text: Commercial vehicle customers pay Rush Enterprises for new and used trucks, aftermarket parts, service, financing, leasing and insurance.
revenueModel.evidence: we provide one-stop service for the needs of our commercial vehicle customers, including retail sales of new and used commercial vehicles, aftermarket parts sales, service and repair facilities, financing, leasing and rental, and insurance products
